name: Waste we produce (Cyprus)
summary: How much municipal waste Cyprus produced in 2023 and 2024, as one number for the whole country. It is not a number for a city or a school.

el.name: Τα απορρίμματά μας (Κύπρος)
el.summary: Πόσα δημοτικά απορρίμματα παρήγαγε η Κύπρος το 2023 και το 2024, ως ένας αριθμός για όλη τη χώρα. Δεν είναι αριθμός για μια πόλη ή ένα σχολείο.

update.note: CYSTAT updates the table about once a year. The server reads a reviewed copy kept in context/ and never fetches a newer one by itself.

quality.uncertainty: A national yearly total. The newest year is provisional and can still change.
known_issues: Only two selected years (2023 and 2024), not the whole series
The recycling figures of the same table are left out: two official copies of the 2023 value do not match

restrictions: Credit CYSTAT wherever this is shown, and say that we converted thousand tonnes to tonnes (CYSTAT is not responsible for that)
Never split the national number between cities or schools, and never add it up four times

use_for: How much municipal waste Cyprus makes in a year
not_for: Waste of a city, a district or a school

notes: Reviewed, frozen file from the research handoff of 13 November 2026 (CYSTAT table 1700010E, retrieved 12 November 2026), kept byte for byte as context/waste-generation-national.json (hash in context/manifest.json). Whether commercial reuse is allowed was not checked. Read by context.js. The brain does not read this layer (x_reads).
